searchText: Hey, I’ve created a tool for generating shared BLS keys in a trustless manner. It’s more useful for the withdrawal key rather than the validator key as some of the steps should be performed on an air-gapped machine and are interactive. Check it out here: https://github.com/stakewise/bls-horcrux
